Questions about Crewd

Before you
install.

The practical details before you bring Crewd into a repo.

Why not just copy the agent files myself?

You can. Crewd handles the repetitive parts: resolving skill dependencies, writing each tool’s native files and recording package versions in a lockfile. Commit the setup so teammates can install it without copying folders by hand.

What happens when I hire an agent?

Crewd downloads the package, resolves its skills and writes the native files for your coding tools. It records the package version and SHA-256 hash in crewd.lock.

Which tools does it support?

Claude Code, Cursor and Gemini CLI. Crewd compiles the same package into each tool’s native format.

Can I review what’s inside a package?

Skills can include scripts. Crewd flags them and points you to crewd interview for review before use.

How do agents in a team work together?

Crewd installs each member and compiles its role into your coding tool’s delegation descriptions. The tool handles delegation; there’s no separate Crewd orchestrator.

Will upgrades remove my custom skills?

Skills you add with crewd teach stay attached when you upgrade the package. Those additions belong to this repository.

Can I try it now?

Crewd is in private beta. Join the private-beta waitlist to request early access. The package names and CLI walkthroughs here are product examples.
